Game Overview

In Four Beauties, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a captivating journey through ancient China in Four Beauties. Solve match-3 puzzles, master sliding challenges, and pour wine with precision. Each level gradually unveils a stunning ink painting, blending traditional aesthetics with modern gameplay, offering a mesmerizing and enriching puzzle experience for all players.
